registration.purpose: Disentangle independent expert-action FM benefit from closed-loop benefit at existing C200, using already materialized six video arms, S200 correct, and identity source
registration.interpretation: Lower correct FM than controls with no closed-loop benefit points to action-distribution or sequential-control limitations; absent correct FM benefit means the trained mapping does not yet use video beneficially under its supervision. Neither alone identifies the unique upstream cause; no loss proxy replaces rollout.
